A2.1 • ENTERTAINMENT AND FREE TIME • LESSON 1 OF 6

What do you like watching?

Read the posters, watch official trailers and talk about your tastes.

Identify movie genres.
Use trailer clues.
Talk about preferences.
Give a reason with because.
1

Poster wall

Choose one broad genre for each real movie poster.

6 min
Genre bank
action • animation • comedy • documentary • drama • fantasy • horror • musical • romance • science fiction • thriller
2

Trailer detective

Watch each 30-second excerpt. Match it to a poster and genre.

12 min
Strategy
First watch: notice music, movement, setting and mood. Second watch: confirm. Keep captions (CC) off.
3

Genre language

A genre names a type. An adjective gives an opinion or mood.

7 min
Genre nounUseful adjectiveExample
comedyfunnyComedies are funny.
action / thrillerexcitingAction movies are exciting.
horrorscaryHorror movies are scary.
romanceromanticIt is a romantic movie.
dramamoving / seriousThe story is moving.
fantasy / sci-fiimaginativeThe world is imaginative.

Match each meaning to an adjective.

Personal prediction

4

Preferences and habits

Use verb + -ing for preferences and simple present for habits.

10 min
PurposePatternExample
strong positivelove + -ingI love watching sci-fi movies.
positivelike / enjoy + -ingI enjoy watching comedies.
neutraldon’t mind + -ingI don’t mind watching dramas.
negativedon’t like / hate + -ingI hate watching horror movies.
habitfrequency + simple presentI usually watch movies at home.
Frequency position
I usually watch… • She often watches… • We sometimes watch… • He never watches…

A. Choose the correct form.

4B

Build complete sentences

Put the words in order, then add your own reasons.

4–5 min

B. Put the words in order.

C. Make it personal with because.

5

Pair survey

Ask, listen and record short answers.

9 min
Conversation frame
What do you usually watch? • Why do you like it? • How often do you watch it?
6

Mini recommendation • My pick

Prepare a 30–45 second recommendation.

8 min
Speaking frame
My pick is… It is a/an… It is about… I like it because… I recommend it to people who like…
7

Exit ticket

Make your progress visible.

4 min

Self-assessment • Scale 1–5

Scale legend: 1 = strongly disagree • 2 = disagree • 3 = neutral • 4 = agree • 5 = strongly agree
Statement12345
8

Homework Mode • Send to Teacher

Write your entertainment profile.

after class
Task • 60–80 words
Write about what you usually watch. Include two preferences, one dislike, one frequency adverb and at least one reason with because. Finish with one movie or series you recommend.

Optional trailer challenge

Choose one official trailer above and write three visual or sound clues.
